description: The deposit provides source code and executables for an anaerobic-digestion simulator created for a mechanical-engineering bachelor's final project. This resource is provided by Carlos Emmanuel de Sá Kattar. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: GPLv3. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The student-project origin explicitly raises Q2; model equations and validation were not established from the short metadata. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
